site.name: Kitchen Finds & Favorites
site.tagline: Hand-picked organization gear for small, busy kitchens — tested against real reviews, not hype.

products.name: Pipishell Bamboo Expandable Silverware Drawer Organizer
products.blurb: Expands from 13" to almost 20" wide, so it actually fits your drawer instead of the other way around. Seven compartments keep forks, spoons, and knives from turning into a junk pile.

products.name: Vtopmart 25-Piece Clear Drawer Organizer Set
products.blurb: Four sizes of clear bins that snap into any drawer layout — junk drawer, utensil drawer, whatever needs taming. Everything stays visible so you stop digging.

products.name: HuggieGems Magnetic Spice Rack, 4-Pack
products.blurb: Sticks straight to the fridge — no drilling, no mounting hardware. Heavy-duty steel shelves free up real cabinet space for spices, oils, and small jars.
